label: human-32
people: [gecko]thebluegecko (34; Cortex, base B3), [gecko]u6bkep (19; Armada vehicles, base B8)
our_side: Three seats under an Opus 5.5 high side commander: t2 = seat 0, Cortex, G3 (middle); t3 = seat 1, Armada, H6 (south); t4 = seat 2, Cortex, H3 (north). Players Opus 5.5 medium (Claude Code 2.1.296); hands Jev jev-latest = 1.13.0. Realtime lobby game hosted by the user (computer_whisperer) as a spectator.
summary: u6bkep opened with a mass of Rovers that took all of t3's extractors by 3:58 and six of t2's by 5:53, while thebluegecko's Rascals and then Incisor swarms raided t4's north from 3:08 to 20:00 (53 of t4's extractors lost, 38 to Incisors). Our side answered at home and held a growing lead over the army it saw (4,700 to 1,600 at 7:50, 18,900 to 7,500 at 16:50), but the first strike west (go_west 7:50) reached his half as three separate bodies at 11:00-12:40 and lost at C7, C6 and C1/D1. After that nothing of ours came within 3,378 of blue's base, the side killed 9 of the people's extractors all game, and every fight from 13:00 was in our half (his losses: 52.6k there, 3.8k in his own half). From 16:50 to 21:00 the side's largest army (about 19k) stood in our half while thebluegecko built an advanced plant and a gantry unseen; his first Shiva shelled t2's spots at 21:03. Eight to eleven Shivas then took t2's and t4's bases while u6bkep's Bulls broke t3 at G6-H6, and the commander conceded at 27:20.

root.what: The first lead went west late and in pieces. From 6:00 the side held 2-9x the army it saw, at home against the Rovers. The commander's go_west at 7:50 sent bodies on three routes: t4's chased Incisors in our half (17 to 4, first stop 9:45), t3's waited at home until 9:06, and t2's was handed to t3 mid-fight at 10:50. They reached his half one at a time at 11:03-12:38 and each lost. From 12:44 our mass never again stood over 30% in his half, and his bases and economy went untouched while he teched.

their_play: Both people opened fast-unit raids at once and kept them up for 20 minutes, while teching behind them unseen. u6bkep (Armada): a Rover mass (about 18, 51 Rovers and Rascals killed by 6:20) into all three homes from 3:05, then Blitzes (7 at G6 7:55), then a Stout and Janus block (3 Stouts at 10:18, 8 Stouts and 3 Janus at 12:44, about 21 and 3 at 14:47) that beat t3's body at E6 at 15:20; Beamer nests at D6/E7 from 19:00; Bulls from about 21:45, 4 at 22:04, 12 at 26:14 and about 20 overrunning H6 at 26:42. thebluegecko (Cortex): Rascals on t4's spots from 3:08, then Incisor swarms through our north and middle from 7:59 (29 on t2's home at 13:20, 21 at t4's home at 20:05, about 200 killed from 13:00 to 19:50); a forward nest at E4/F4 (a Twin Guard and three Exploiters by 12:39, three Twin Guards and dragon's teeth by 17:24); tier 2 seen at 19:24; a gantry, with the first Shiva at 21:03, 8 at 22:41 and 10-11 by 24:20, plus 14-15 Graverobbers behind them and Wasp gunships by 26:53. Every fight from 13:00 was in our half (his mass 'our half %' 100 from 14:00), and neither person's base was hit after 7:00 (the three extractors of theirs killed later, at 17:23-20:39, stood in our half).

bears_on.note: A lead over the seen army (4,700/1,600 at 7:50, 18,900/7,500 at 16:50) was never taken to his base, and it went bad on the Shiva switch. Caveat: the lead is against floors.
Three bodies reached his half one at a time (11:03-12:38) and lost each fight; W1 and Y2 then went into the Shivas separately.

The concession named the Shiva switch; the people's economy was never touched after 7:00 (9 of their extractors killed all game, the last near his bases at 6:58) while we lost 136. No truth file shows their count.
The side held its half (51 extractors at 16:00) but raided nothing after 7:00; it was the people who raided our corners.
The first scouts crossed at 2:13-2:54 and killed constructors and a cormex at 4:08; the pressure stopped after 7:00, and both people teched unchecked.
18.2k of wrecks lay 'where no enemy' by 18:07, uncollected; the people ran Graverobbers.
Our tier 2 started at 19:11 and 21:25 and fielded nothing; the people went to tier 2 and 3 behind their raids.
t2 massed Lashers ('11 Lashers is already too many', 19:11) and tier-1 riot units while thebluegecko went to a gantry.
W1 walked into the E4/F4 Twin Guard nest at 17:14 (35 to 24), and at 21:21 into the Shiva beside the Twin Guards.
The E4/F4 nest held all game and shelled t2's spots; tier-1 bodies never cracked it.
t2's plant ran out of its list at 19:11; t3's stood idle at 21:25 with 898 metal.

lens.caveats: There is no truth file (a human game, and no replay dump), so every number of theirs is a floor of what we saw. The side's ratios sum three seats against two people's floors, so the 'lead' may be overstated: t3 found green's block 'far heavier than we knew' at 14:47. The per-match tools read record-0 only, so seats 1 and 2 were read through symlink directories in the scratchpad. pro_baseline was not run (Comet only; no cards for this map). wake_read covers seat 0 only. There is no ledger row and no computer_whisperer line, so no person's reading of the game exists beyond 'gg wp'. The people's tech clocks are inferred from first sightings. The match directory holds impedance-review.md and unfinished-review.md (no review.md); this row agrees with their items and adds the strategic chain.

open_questions: When did thebluegecko start his advanced plant and gantry, and how many extractors did the two people hold at 12:00-20:00? A replay dump through run/replay_match.py would give their truth.
Would one body sent at 6:30-8:00 have won in his half, given that green's block was heavier than seen?
Has the report's wording for an unidentified radar contact ('we outweigh it heavily') been fixed since?
Why did W1 stand at F4 from 20:38 (when the strike packet landed) to 21:21: the pick's hold, or the player's 20:43 rewrite putting 'shell the Twin Guards first'?
